XVII, 11</cite>) <he>נִדְנַדְתֶּם עליכם קצירן וכ׳</he> (or <he>קצירין</he>; Ar. <he>נִדַּדְתֶּם</he>, fr. <cite ref="N00211"><he>נָדַד</he></cite>) (through your willing acceptance of the Law) you had made powerless over you the harvest (harvests, destructive forces) of the governments &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 287">Yalk. Is. 287</cite> <he>נדית עלי</he> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53:10">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> <he>לא נִדְנְדָה עריסה וכ׳</he> never was a cradle rocked before it was rocked in the house of Abraham, i.e. never before was there such a festival at the weaning of a child.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ex. R. s. 20</cite>, end <he>נ׳ הארון</he> Joseph’s coffin (sunk in the Nile) was stirred up (and came to the surface; Tanḥ. Ekeb 6 <cite ref="G00589"><he>נזדעזע</he></cite>; Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:10">Cant. R. to VI, 10</cite> (play on <he>כנ̇ד̇ג̇ל̇ו̇ת̇</he>, <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:10">ib.</cite>) <he>כדור שנתנ̇ד̇נ̇ד̇ לג̇ל̇ו̇ת̇ו</he> like the generation (of Hezekiah) that was stirred up for its exile; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:10:1">ib.</cite> <he>כדור שנ׳ לגלות ולא גילה</he> (read: <he>שיִתְנַדְנֵד … ולא יגלה</he>) like the generation (of the Messiah) which shall be moved about as if to go into exile, but shall not go.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:10:1">Ib.</cite> <he>מִתְנַדְנְדִים ממסע וכ׳</he> moving from journey to journey; a. e.
